title: Enter the Hive
description: The Bumblezone is a deep native progression system rather than a single novelty dimension. Enter its advancement tree and tame a Beehemoth, using the dimension's own recorded milestones instead of converting every bee mechanic into a REIGN checklist.
description_completed: The Overlord has entered the Bumblezone's native progression and secured a Beehemoth ally.

prerequisites.name: Establish the first foundation of the reign
